product_metadata.title: SOPEOE 2PCS Vegetable Potato Peelers for Kitchen Tool for Fruit,Apple,Carrot,Cucumber Peeler Set Straight Y-Shaped and I-Shaped Plastic 2-Pack Durable Non-Slip Handle Green
features: [2PIECES] This set of 2 Kitchen peelers includes Y-Shaped & I-Shaped peeler with swivel blades for your choice.
[Ergonomic Design] Both peelers work in right or left hand to peel conveniently, maintains a firm grip for your easy handing.

[Multi-Purpose] The rotating peeler blade is made of high-quality stainless steel and can slide off the vegetables. The rotation function allows quick pulling, which is very suitable for long vegetables such as carrots and cucumbers. Its dual blades provide angular flexibility, allowing you to peel off in any direction. Compared with a fixed blade, it can adapt to any form of surface to be cut, so that the peeling becomes thinner continuously.
[Easy to Clean] Easy to Clean Safe in the dishwasher, our kitchen peeler eliminates the hassle of your post-meal clean up!
